sources.note: matches the 2^28 row of the snarkjs README table, which supports that the table is accurate; it does NOT list the 2^15 file. The 2^28 file is 309 GB, so the 2^15 file cannot be re-derived from it here.

status: PROVISIONAL: the 2^15 hash is published by one source (snarkjs README; the same table is copied by forks and packages, so those are not independent) and the file passes a full cryptographic verification (54 contributions + beacon). The table is corroborated for the parent 2^28 file by an independent publication (Hermez). Still needed before the real ceremony: one more INDEPENDENT publication of the 2^15 hash, or a second party who downloads the file from a different host and compares blake2b (see docs/ceremony_b1_plan.md section 7).
